g.text: MarinMoE 1.5B–60M: AR training and FIM annealing
#593 evaluated with fast-fa3. Rose: whole-motif prediction; muted: Evo 2–style scoring. Speeds projected from #586.
† Evo 2 20B speed uses the 7B rate. ‡ PlantCAD1 quality: 512 bp; other models: 8,192 bp.
